changes: Implemented Baseline 2-5 local CLI runner, suite report aggregation, and capability claim evaluation with fail-closed proof gates. Added smoke coverage for stale artifacts, local-only proof rejection, suite report coherence, and lower-layer claim authorization.
usage: Run node packages/main/dist/cli.js baseline_run --baselineId=ENG-BUGFIX-1 --format=json; run baseline_suite_report --layer=engineering --format=json; run capability_claim_evaluate --target=production-safety --format=json; or run npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke.
expectedOutcome: The CLI exposes baseline_run, baseline_suite, baseline_suite_report, and capability_claim_evaluate. Local artifacts can be generated, but stale/local/incoherent proof is blocked and production-safety claims remain unauthorized without real authority evidence.
actualTranscript: Real-machine commands showed the four CLI commands in help output. baseline_suite_report --layer=engineering returned suiteStatus=BLOCKED, authorization=not_authorized, outcome=EXPECTED_BLOCK with missing lower-layer proof and stale artifact reasons. capability_claim_evaluate --target=production-safety returned authorized=false, authorizedClaimLevel=none, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible mismatch: actual CLI behavior matches the expected fail-closed local diagnostic capability.
limitations: Production-safety and production-grade unattended claims remain intentionally blocked without external Authority receipts, multi-host proof, and soak evidence. Local reports are diagnostic artifacts, not public capability proof.
pitfalls: Review found and fixed five correctness blockers: stale coverage overclaim, local stub false PASS, permanently locked lower-layer claims, invalid final-report status acceptance, and incoherent suite proof authorization. Future changes must preserve fail-closed proof gates.
